content.title: Options if Southwest Cancels Your Flight | Southwest Airlines
content.text: We're sorry your flight was canceled by Southwest®. You have a few options available. Traveling on an itinerary involving a partner airline? Review important details. Option #1: Continue with your travel plans In most cases, if Southwest cancels your flight, you will be automatically rebooked on another Southwest flight to your destination. If Southwest texts or emails you with a new itinerary, your new reservation is confirmed, and you don't need to do anything else. Option #2: Change your flight If your new itinerary doesn't work or you aren't automatically rebooked, you can change your flight date and/or time by up to 14 days from your original travel date at no additional cost. The quickest and easiest way to do this is to visit Southwest.com/rebook and enter your name and confirmation number. Option #3: Cancel your reservation and choose flight credit If you decide not to travel, you can receive a flight credit or Transferable Flight Credit™ (depending on the type of fare purchased) toward future travel rather than a refund. A Transferable Flight Credit can be transferred once between Rapid Rewards® Members. Flight credits and Transferable Flight Credits have a specified expiration date. All travel must be completed by the expiration date. If your flight is canceled by Southwest and you choose a flight credit when canceling your reservation, your flight credit will be valid for five years. You must cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes before the flight’s original scheduled departure. Reservations that are not flown and not canceled are subject to our no-show policy. Option #4: Cancel your reservation and choose a method-of-payment refund When you cancel your reservation, you will be presented with the option to receive a refund of your unused airfare. Generally, refunds are processed to the original form of payment and are processed by Southwest within seven (7) business days.Please cancel your reservation at least 10 minutes prior to original scheduled departure.
